compound_subjects_with_and.rule: Plural agreement unless denoting a single unified concept
compound_subjects_with_and.example_plural: The engineer and the scientist are collaborating.

correlative_either_or.rule: Verb agrees with the nearest subject conjunct (Proximity Principle)
correlative_either_or.example_1: Neither the manager nor the employees were informed.
correlative_either_or.example_2: Neither the employees nor the manager was informed.

collective_nouns.rule: Singular in American English (focus on unit); plural in British English (focus on individuals)

quantifiers_with_of_phrase.rule: Verb agrees with the object of preposition (count vs mass)
quantifiers_with_of_phrase.example_mass: Most of the data is clean.
quantifiers_with_of_phrase.example_count: Most of the parameters are updated.
